bodySections.heading: Why SDN/NFV Is Essential in Telecommunications
bodySections.content: Employers look for verified proficiency in SDN/NFV to ensure team productivity, project accuracy, and modern technical capability. Candidates with demonstrated SDN/NFV expertise consistently outperform those with only theoretical knowledge.
bulletPoints: SDN/NFV is listed as a required skill in over 60% of telecommunications job postings.
Employers prioritise candidates with verifiable skills over self-declared expertise.
Proficiency in SDN/NFV accelerates career progression by 1–3 years on average.
Use TalentXcel Skills Assessment to verify and showcase your proficiency.

bodySections.heading: How to Learn and Demonstrate SDN/NFV
bodySections.content: The most effective way to build SDN/NFV proficiency is through a combination of structured learning, hands-on project work, and verified assessment. Showcasing your skill through a verified credential on TalentXcel significantly improves recruiter visibility.
bulletPoints: Start with structured online courses covering SDN/NFV fundamentals.
Build 2–3 real portfolio projects that demonstrate practical application.
Complete the TalentXcel Skills Assessment to earn a verified credential.
List the credential on your Career Passport and resume.
